title: Token response record with the expiry rule kept outside it
task: Package `oauth` decodes a token response JSON `{"access_token":"...","expires_in":3600,"token_type":"Bearer"}` into a `TokenResponse` record with those three fields. Callers then need to know whether a token obtained at a given time has expired as of another given time. Keep the record a plain record for JSON and put the expiry rule where it belongs. Test decoding and the expiry boundary exactly at expires_in seconds.
